description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericXaResource' that implements the XAResource interface and extends Thread, providing a base implementation for managing a single transaction in a distributed transaction system. It includes methods for transaction enlistment, start, end, prepare, recover, and timeout handling.

classes.name: GenericXaResource
classes.description: An abstract class implementing XAResource and extending Thread, supporting transaction enlistment, timeout, and recovery.

methods.name: enlist
methods.description: Enlists this resource in the current transaction or a specified transaction.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a transaction branch with a given Xid and flag.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the work performed on behalf of a transaction branch.

methods.name: forget
methods.description: Forgets a heuristically completed transaction branch.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the transaction branch for commit.

methods.name: recover
methods.description: Recovers transaction branches in a given recovery scenario.

methods.name: isSameRM
methods.description: Checks if another XAResource is the same resource manager.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Abstract method to commit a transaction branch.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Abstract method to rollback a transaction branch.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Thread run method handling transaction timeout logic.
